East Side Social Ride

Denton, TX · Downtown · Social

No-drop

East Side Social Ride is a social group ride in Denton, TX. It rolls every Thursday at 7:30 pm from East Side Denton. About 12–15 miles, 11–14 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 11–14 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the East Side Social Ride group ride

Denton's biggest Thursday ride. Meets at East Side bar off the square, rolls about 12 to 15 miles at 11 to 14 mph, and ends back at the bar. No-drop.
